newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan posts Y2.93 trln appraised forex profits - MOF.
newsitem.headline: Japan posts Y2.93 trln appraised forex profits - MOF.

text.p: Japan posted 2.932 trillion yen in appraisal profits in its special foreign exchange accounts in the 1996/97 fiscal year, a senior Ministry of Finance official said on Thursday.

Eisuke Sakakibara, director-general of the Finance Ministry's International Finance Bureau, told a parliamentary committee that as the result of the gains, accumulated appraisal losses in the accounts shrank to 7.1603 trillion yen by the end of the 1996/97 fiscal year from 10.0923 trillion yen in the previous fiscal year-end.
